answer_1.quote: Pre-trained language models are commonly instruction-tuned for user-facing applications to generate high-quality responses to task-oriented prompts.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates prompts and model outputs aimed at extracting memorized training data from LLMs, particularly focusing on regurgitation of pre-training content such as code, books, and articles.
